annotations.title: Recommend the measured best model for a task (score, cost per correct)

description: Recommends what to call for a task from our own measurements: the rows on the measured frontier (top score or cheapest cost per correct output), each with score, cost per correct, n, date, source and the gaents alias or job to call. Measured tasks now: coding, ner, ner-conll2003, ocr, pixel-canary-profile, placement, roar, s1, transcription, transcription-h2h15, tts. Use it to choose a model or job for one of those tasks before paying for runs. Use models_list instead for every model's price and verdict at once, free. Use chat instead to run the recommended alias. Cost: $0.005 per answered task, debited from your balance; a task we have not measured answers 'not measured' and is free. Auth: Authorization: Bearer <API key> (POST https://api.gaents.com/v1/accounts, $0.10 free credit); with no key the call returns a signed 402 quote payable in BSV or USDC via x402. Errors (isError, error.code): 400 task_required, 401 bad_api_key, 402 low balance.

task.description: A task id from the list above, or words matched against task names (e.g. extraction).

name: recommend

call.description: how to call it here: {model, path, mcp_tool, available} or null when not offered

correct_unit.description: what counts as one correct output

cost_per.description: the number of correct outputs the cost is per

cost_per_correct_usd.description: USD per cost_per correct outputs (null = cost unknown)

provider.description: the provider measured (bench rows; hidden when show.owned_by is false)

roles.description: top score and/or cheapest known cost per correct output, on its item set

score.description: primary quality score on the task (0-1)

score_ci.description: [lower, upper] interval of the score when the source gives one

score_key.description: which quality column the score is

source.description: the source file of the measurement

subject.description: the alias, job (job:<slug>) or model measured
